 Appearance:

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Shri K.C. Ghildiyal - Senior Advocate assisted with Shr  Thakur - Advocate for the petitioner.
 Shri Siddharth Shukla Pl appeared for respondent.

ORDER This is a petition assailing the order dated 09/06/2025 (Annexure P/1) by which the petitioner who is working as Auxiliary Nurse Midwife is being sought to be transferred from Urban Primary Health Center, Vinobanagar, Betul District Betul (wrongly mentioned as Urban Primary Health Center Ambedkar Ward) to Chief Medical and Health Officer District Narmadapuram.
2.

entities.text: Urban Primary Health Center Ambedkar Ward
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Counsel for the petitioner contends that previously the petitioner made an application for transfer on her own expenses as his husband is also working as Food Safety Officer at Betul.
The said request was acceded which ensued passing of order dated 07/07/2023 (Annexure P/2).
Thus, the impugned order dated 09/06/20254 has been issued in complete violation of Clause 23 of the transfer policy.

It is contended by the counsel that by NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:32270 2 WP-26309-2025 highlighting her grievance the petitioner has already moved a representation (Annexure P/7) dated 13/06/2025 therefore, prays that the authority concerned be directed to consider and decide the same in accordance with law.
3.

The counsel for the State submits that the impugned order has been passed in view of the administrative exigency, however, the representation of the petitioner shall be dealt with in accordance with law.

sentences.text: 4. In view of the aforesaid, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the present petition stands disposed of with direction to respondent No.2 to take decision on the representation (Annexure P-7) dated 13/06/2025 submitted by the petitioner within a period of 30 days from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order, by passing a well reasoned and speaking order in accordance with law.

5. For a period of 30 days or till the decision on the representation of the petitioner (whichever is earlier), the petitioner shall be permitted to continue at her present place of posting i.e. Urban Primary Health Center, Vinobanagar, Betul District Betul.
5. Accordingly the petition stands disposed of.
